screening.deduplication: NFKC normalize, collapse whitespace, casefold, replace runs outside ASCII a-z/0-9 with one space, and strip; group identical nonempty normalized titles; retain first record ID, concatenate source-ID memberships, and retain earliest nonzero publication year. Fallback keys for an empty normalized title: arXiv ID, DOI, then OpenAlex ID.

annual_to_screening_relationship.screening_search_expression: fulltext.search with Computer Science primary field

limitations: The July annual series are preserved dated observations; the original HTTP responses or Google Scholar page captures and exact access times are unavailable.
The July Google Scholar records omit exact year-filter URLs and locale. No such parameters have been invented.
The OpenAlex annual URL records search.exact and grouping, but is not a saved request/response log; completeness of other request settings cannot be certified.
The screening pool and annual count series use different dates, search expressions and field restrictions. Their totals must not be treated as the same denominator.

The collector-run metadata records a source hash that does not match the surviving collector or either recovered Git version. The excerpt documents surviving code; the exact historical executable was not recovered.

The candidate packet preserves grouped identifiers and retained years, not complete pre-deduplication API responses. Two source IDs appear twice within their groups; 651 memberships therefore contain 649 distinct IDs.
Current database queries cannot independently validate historical result totals.
